'''Tahm Rendu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], together with [[Jace Rendu]] and [[Shan Burku]], until the three were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial-allied individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Tahm Rendu appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Elite boss on Corellia. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
